whenToUse: Detail screens with many reviews, such as products or apps.
The average alone is hard to judge by.
People want to see low-score reviews first.
whenNotToUse: There are only a few reviews (a rating badge is enough).
Tight spots such as cards (use a rating badge).
Places where the text matters more than the score.

alternatives.name: Rating Badge
alternatives.reason: Showing it briefly on a card.

alternatives.name: Filter Chip
alternatives.reason: Filtering by conditions other than score.

accessibility: Bar buttons are aria-pressed, and their names include the score and count.
The filtered state is announced in a role=status message.
Counts use tabular-nums to line up the digits.
